scenes.hook: JavaScript Variables. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: Variables give names to values used by your program. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: Use let when you need to reassign a variable. Read the example from top to bottom.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw. Small changes in code can change the output.
scenes.tip: Use const when the binding should not be reassigned. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: Const does not make the contents of an object immutable. Understanding this helps you avoid a common beginner mistake.
scenes.try: Store your name and a score, then increase the score. Change one part, then compare your result.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
